name: element/sentinel
description: Sentinel is a PHP 7.4+ framework agnostic fully-featured authentication & authorization system. It also provides additional features such as user roles and additional security features.

suggest.illuminate/database: Required if you want to use the Eloquent repository adapter
suggest.php8: This package utilizes features that are found in 7.4 - But if you use php8 or higher, then you should have no problems
